propositions: Duplicated decision logic exists across 2-7 code locations; fixes in one copy leave twins broken, causing multi-ticket installments
Consolidation children collapse each duplicated computation into one shared module with construct-uniqueness guards that assert exactly one implementation exists
Guard-test construction requires scanning src/rebar for distinctive atom conjunctions or AST shapes, never single tokens, with mandatory # <construct>-ok reason markers for legitimate second uses
No consolidation child changes pinned observable behaviour; pre-existing test assertions remain unchanged and construct-uniqueness tests pass in default Verified tier
Acceptance criteria AC2 (tests-only-additions) and AC3 (net-negative lines) are violated by correct consolidation work and need restating to measure actual guarantees rather than proxies
